description: Lidless: move a session to the cloud and back from its own window, which stays open (the prompt hook carries out /lidless:away and back and waits for them; while the session is away prompts are held and tool calls refused); tell a resumed session where it has been; after each turn, send what changed to your bucket (lidless presync off stops it)

hooks.statusMessage: Lidless: checking this session (a move or a return takes about half a minute; the tab title shows the step)
